test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Anamika, Gopal, Nischal, Vanmayi, Shresta and Sripad are sitting in a straight line facing the north. Nischal is to the immediate left of Gopal. Shresta is between Anamika and Sripad. Sripad is at the second place from the right end. Four persons are sitting between Nischal and Vanmayi. If Gopal and Sripad interchange their positions, then who will be sitting between Vanmayi and Shresta?
solution:
**Anamika, Gopal, Nischal, Vanmayi, Shresta and Sripad** are sitting in a straight l
ine facing the north. 

1. Sripad is at the second place from the right end.

2. Shresta is between Anamika and Sripad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e2e46a24b9fcfd56dcaef921a8d1f08918e0834fd702ad664c3570a1bbc954f.png] 

3. Nischal is to the immediate left of Gopal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/358a38d7194b922082504520b059d5fc6c2fa7ce3b9407ebec437f2a7259acf6.png] 

4. Four persons are sitting between Nischal and Vanmayi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8d6fa5c0efceffcc045e309c27f91f095eea35e8984a563b800985b74a7f07e.png] 

If Gopal and Sripad interchange their positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d790b03b77136fba0e37e6c945085cec89a0d92c7ac952ee0878b392d6a32359.png] 

Then Gopal will be sitting between Vanmayi and Shresta.

Hence, 'Gopal' is the correct answer.
